title: 第732章 许溟怒火第731章 龙筋决意
lines: 陆沉想要一次性打造出两件趁手的玄兵。
但是整理的时候发现所需要的材料还差一点。
不多，但缺就是缺。
他手中的千炼玄铁只有朝廷赐下的五十斤。
打造一柄兵刃尚可，再想多做一件便捉襟见肘。
更何况炼制兵刃还要不少的辅料。
不过他不急。
只要放出话去，道城的那些商会，加上六扇门的渠道，都会帮他去找。
等上几天，材料凑齐了再去府城也不迟。
回到道城时，沈爷，董霸，戚仲光等人已经回了安宁县。
沈爷年事已高，经不起长途奔波，能来一趟已是给足了陆沉面子。
董霸倒是想多留几日，只是安宁县那边一摊子事离不开他，手底下的兄弟越来越多，想要跟他抢地盘的人也自然就多了。
戚仲光走时没有多说什么，只是看向陆沉的目光中带着几分期许。
陆沉在侯府中只待了两日，便收到了六扇门送来的急报。
总捕谢星河被临时调离道城，配合岭南玄教去查一桩案子。
这封调令来得突然，谢星河的命使送来消息时，还附了一封谢星河亲笔书信。
信中只有寥寥数语，是谢星河的口吻：“这种调令此前虽有过，但极少有人会将它用在我头上，如今这般异常，必是有人已经忍不住要对你动手了。”
陆沉将信纸折好，收入袖中，对那命使说：“无事，让总捕放心，若真是有人想要来找我，我也乐意奉陪。”
命使走后，陆沉将红拂与曲红唤到书房。
他将所需材料的清单递过去，从蛟筋到深海寒铁，林林总总写了小半页纸。
曲红接过清单，仔细看了一遍，心中大致有了计较。
“侯爷放心，这些东西，道城的商会凑一凑，加上六扇门的渠道，几日便能收齐。”
曲红将清单收入袖中，语气笃定。
红拂站在一旁，欲言又止。
她沉默了许久，还是开了口：“侯爷，总捕被调离这件事，太巧了，巧到像是有人故意将他支开，您一个人留在道城，我怕……”
“怕他们对我动手？”陆沉笑了笑，“宗师之上，已经不是寻常人能应付的了。”
“你们帮不上忙，我也不需要你们帮忙。”
“只要你们能尽快将我需要的材料备齐，便是最大的帮助。”
他的语气很平淡，可那平淡之下压着的东西，红拂听得出来。
她没有再劝，只是点了点头。
曲红张了张嘴，还想说些什么，可在陆沉那淡淡的目光下，还是将到嘴边的话咽了回去。
她太了解陆沉了，知道他一旦做了决定，九头牛都拉不回来。
陆沉没有在侯府多留。
他将需要交代的事情交代完，便动身出了道城，朝着三百里外那片荒山的方向掠去。
他没有遮掩气息，甚至刻意将气息外放了几分，像一盏在黑夜中点燃的灯，明晃晃地亮着，不怕人看见，就怕人看不见。
content_en:
Lu Chen wanted to create two handy mysterious weapons at once.
But when I was sorting it out, I found that the required materials were still lacking.
Not much, but what is lacking is what is lacking.
The Thousand Refined Black Iron in his hand was only fifty kilograms given by the imperial court.
It's okay to make one weapon, but if you want to make one more, you'll be short of money.
What's more, refining weapons requires a lot of auxiliary materials.
But he was in no hurry.
As long as he spreads the word, the chambers of commerce in Daocheng, as well as the channels of Six Gates, will help him find it.
After waiting for a few days, it would not be too late to go to Fucheng after gathering all the materials.
When they returned to Daocheng, Master Shen, Dong Ba, Qi Zhongguang and others had already returned to Anning County.
Mr. Shen is already old and cannot afford to travel long distances. Being able to come here is enough to give Lu Chen a lot of face.
Dong Ba wanted to stay for a few more days, but he couldn't do anything without him in Anning County. With more and more brothers under his command, there were naturally more people who wanted to compete with him for territory.
Qi Zhongguang didn't say much when he left, but looked at Lu Chen with a bit of expectation.
Lu Chen only stayed in the Hou Mansion for two days before he received urgent reports from six doors.
Chief Inspector Xie Xinghe was temporarily transferred out of Daocheng to cooperate with Lingnan Xuanjiao to investigate a case.
This transfer order came suddenly. When Xie Xinghe's envoy sent the news, he also attached a letter written by Xie Xinghe.
There were only a few words in the letter, which was Xie Xinghe's tone: "Although this kind of transfer order has been done before, very few people would use it on my head. Now that it is so abnormal, someone must have been unable to help but attack you."
Lu Chen folded the letter, put it in his sleeve, and said to the envoy: "Nothing, please rest assured, Chief. If someone really wants to come find me, I will be happy to accompany you."
After the envoy left, Lu Chen called Hongfu and Qu Hong to the study.
He handed over the list of required materials, covering everything from dragon tendons to deep-sea cold iron, which took up half a page.
Qu Hong took the list, read it carefully, and had some thoughts in mind.
"Don't worry, Lord Marquis, these things can be collected in a few days by the Chamber of Commerce in Daocheng and the channels of six doors."
Qu Hong put the list in his sleeve and spoke firmly.
Hongfu stood aside, hesitant to speak.
She was silent for a long time, and finally spoke: "Master Hou, it is such a coincidence that the Chief Constable was transferred away. It seems like someone deliberately removed him. You are left alone in Daocheng. I'm afraid..."
"Afraid they will do something to me?" Lu Chen smiled, "Beyond the Grandmaster, it is no longer something ordinary people can handle."
"You can't help me, and I don't need your help."
"As long as you can prepare the materials I need as soon as possible, it will be the greatest help."
His tone was very calm, but Hong Fu could hear something underlying that calmness.
She didn't try to persuade him any more and just nodded.
Qu Hong opened his mouth and wanted to say something, but under Lu Chen's indifferent gaze, he swallowed the words that came to his lips.
She knew Lu Chen too well and knew that once he made a decision, not even nine cows could pull him back.
Lu Chen did not stay in the Hou Mansion longer.
After he finished explaining what needed to be explained, he left Daocheng and headed towards the barren mountains three hundred miles away.
He did not cover up his aura, and even deliberately let it out a little, like a lamp lit in the dark night, shining brightly, not afraid of being seen, but afraid of being invisible.
